| camera_positions.geojson   | Where OpenDroneMap placed each camera after the block adjustment, from its shots.geojson                                                                                                                                                  | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight                                      |
| report.json                | OpenDroneMap's processing statistics and the full orthophoto's metadata                                                                                                                                                                   | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight                                      |
| points_sample.npz          | 100 000 points of the classified dense cloud as offsets from an origin, with colours and class codes                                                                                                                                      | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight                                      |
| check_windows.csv          | The orthomosaic against the 2022 NAIP flight by phase correlation in 60 m windows: the shift that moves the orthomosaic onto the State's photograph, window by window                                                                     | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight                                      |
